note: Curated editing-intelligence feed (M48 §13). Entries are evergreen platform specifications or established professional practice with verifiable official sources. NO proprietary presets, project files or copyrighted assets are copied. A trend never overwrites a user's chosen style; RIISHE surfaces it with evidence on request.

entries.name: YouTube upload encoding standard
entries.description: Recommended upload encoding: MP4 with fast-start moov atom, H.264 progressive High Profile CABAC 4:2:0 closed GOP at half the frame rate, AAC-LC/Opus at 48 kHz; SDR BT.709; VBR guidance ~8 Mbps 1080p30, 35-45 Mbps 4K; encode at the recorded frame rate.
entries.audioStrategy: 48 kHz AAC-LC/Opus; 128 kbps mono / 384 kbps stereo
entries.evidenceSummary: Page fetched live on 2026-11-27: fast-start MP4, H.264 High Profile, closed GOP at half frame rate, BT.709 SDR, VBR bitrate table, deinterlace guidance.
capabilityRequirements: delivery profiles map: container mp4, codec h264, audio aac 48kHz

entries.name: Short-form hook-first vertical pattern
entries.description: Vertical short-form across YouTube Shorts / Instagram Reels / TikTok converges on: mid-action hook in the first ~2 seconds, beat-aligned cuts, caption-forward storytelling, loopable close, safe-area awareness for UI overlays.
entries.visualGrammar: vertical 9:16; center-weighted framing; text kept inside platform safe areas
entries.pacingPattern: 0.6-2.0 s shots; hook before any title card
entries.transitionStrategy: hard cuts on beats; whip/pan matched transitions as accents
entries.evidenceSummary: Established cross-platform professional practice synthesized from platform delivery documentation and the M48 recipe registry; pattern claims are practice-level, not platform-official (confidence: ESTABLISHED-PRACTICE).
entries.confidence: ESTABLISHED-PRACTICE (delivery spec verified; retention pattern is practice consensus)
entries.licenseRestrictions: trend audio MUST be user-owned/licensed — never bundled or fetched

entries.name: News/broadcast packages run without music beds
entries.description: Standard broadcast news practice: no music bed under factual reporting; actuality/nat-sound opens; archival material clearly labeled; lower-third identification discipline.
entries.audioStrategy: voice sacred; nat-sound under b-roll; NO music bed
entries.evidenceSummary: Evergreen professional principle encoded in the news-package recipe; no external source fetched (practice-level, confidence: ESTABLISHED-PRACTICE).

entries.name: ACES color-managed finishing pipeline (awareness)
entries.description: ACES/SMPTE color-managed pipelines standardize input interpretation, a working color space and output transforms for cross-device-consistent finishing. BEAN FX documents this as AWARENESS ONLY — no ACES transform or metadata path is implemented in M48.
entries.colorStrategy: input transform → working space → output transform (documented concept; NOT implemented in BEAN FX)
risksAndAntiPatterns: claiming ACES support without an implemented transform path
entries.evidenceSummary: SMPTE ACES standards page referenced by the M48 specification; NOT fetched in this milestone — recorded as roadmap awareness with the URL for the owner's review.
capabilityRequirements: color management roadmap item — NOT IMPLEMENTED (disclosed)
entries.licenseRestrictions: ACES is a SMPTE standard; implementation would follow the standard's terms
